instructions.mission: Create comprehensive story context for Epic {epic_num} Story {story_num}

steps.step: The target story is already determined from the sprint status queue. Epic: {epic_num}, Story: {story_num}, Key: {story_key}

Load and analyze: - Epic definition and story requirements from the epic file - Previous story learnings (if story_num > 1, check for prior story files in the implementation artifacts directory) - Recent git history (last 5 commits) for project context
Extract from the architecture document: - Architectural guardrails and constraints - Design patterns to follow - Stack requirements and dependencies - File structure conventions
Verify latest information: - Library versions and compatibility - API documentation for referenced services - Best practices for the technology stack

Create the story file using the template with: - User story statement (As a... I want... So that...) - Acceptance criteria derived from the epic - Tasks and subtasks mapped to acceptance criteria - Developer notes with architecture patterns and constraints - Source tree components to create or modify - Testing standards and requirements
Mark the story as "ready-for-dev" in sprint-status.yaml. Update the story key {story_key} status from "backlog" to "ready-for-dev".
